notes.title: Hotfix - Furniture Placement Fix
notes.content:
Hey shopkeepers!

Just shipped a quick hotfix to resolve an annoying issue some players were experiencing:

Fixed: An issue where  shelves or displays that had products on them couldn’t be placed back down after being picked up.

Furniture now behaves properly—if it has products, it won’t be picked up, and if it’s empty, it can be moved and placed again like normal. This should smooth out your decorating and organizing experience!

Thanks so much to everyone who reported this and helped  track it down. If you run into any other weirdness, drop us a note here or in the community hub.
